= Key Fixtures Notice

This directory contains compatibility fixtures used by RusTTY regression tests.

The PuTTY `PPK` fixtures in this directory are derived from
`internal-russh-forked-ssh-key` interoperability test examples and are kept
solely to validate PuTTY-compatible key-loading behavior in RusTTY.

RusTTY's PuTTY attribution requirements still apply to these compatibility
fixtures. See xref:../../../NOTICE.adoc[NOTICE.adoc].
